provenance_model_explained.one_sentence: cybrik-suite operates a TWO-PART release binding: this in-repository manifest binds the AUTHORING PARENT CONTENT BASE — for cybrik-suite, exactly 7dfb8c278c4184495586bf15b0811787b3665b63 — and the external release-candidate TAG v1.0.0-rc1 binds the final POST-MERGE release.

part_1_content_base.binds: The exact commits that were EVALUATED: one pre-merge pull-request head per product repository, plus the cybrik-suite AUTHORING PARENT of the commit that carries this manifest.
part_1_content_base.cybrik_suite_content_base: 7dfb8c278c4184495586bf15b0811787b3665b63 — the authoring parent of the commit carrying this revision, verified 3/3 green under GitHub Actions run 32527288344 at exactly that head.
part_1_content_base.why_the_authoring_parent: A manifest cannot contain its own commit SHA — the commit that writes these bytes is hashed only after the bytes are fixed. The cybrik-suite pin is therefore necessarily the authoring parent, and is a content-base marker rather than a claim that the pin is the released Suite commit. It follows that the pin ADVANCES with each revision of this manifest: bb3eb597 bound the prior revision, 7dfb8c27 binds this one, and each is a truthful record of what was evaluated at its own revision.
